states.passed: Real evidence at the final candidate: the operation ran through the installed CLI against the authenticated service in a journey cited from a dated live record (a harness step or an issue-901-cli8-live json), with its observable effect and applicable denial, revision and retry cases; synthetic fixtures alone never qualify.
states.bounded: Covered only by deterministic or synthetic fixtures (fixture runtime, scripted or fake GitHub, seeded recovery facts, in-process or packed CLI, loopback or a throwaway-certificate TLS proxy) or by a live observation at an earlier candidate; the gap states the bound.
states.unproved: No test at this candidate invokes the operation through the CLI against the authenticated service; the gap states the missing check.

CLI01.basis: In-process and packed-binary (loopback and throwaway-certificate TLS proxy) investigation of tasks, results, instructions, execution inputs and configuration diffs against a real service with fixture runtimes (CLI1-CLI3, CLI7 records) and one live Codex read at 06c12130. Missing: a live host journey at this candidate through the installed binary, a Keychain login through auth login, and any second-machine private-HTTPS run.

CLI02.basis: Chromium credential lifecycle suite, verifier-only storage, read-scope denial of write and side-effect routes, session-only and legacy route denial, and expiry or revocation during follow, all against fixture services.
